text.description_html:
Salem Collection with MacKenzie Lever, BRA-D07-L150x

The Salem Collection with a 2" backset latch is specifically designed for use on swing patio doors, including Atrium doors with sliding screens. Satin nickel finish.

Features of the Salem Collection with MacKenzie Lever:

  • Rose and lever material: Solid Brass
  • Backset: 2"
  • Concealed mounting on Rosette
  • Rosette diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Function: Passage
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Sold as complete set with all mounting hardware
  • All Brass Assents finishes are hand-rubbed and assembled in the USA
